flash: openocd -f openocd.cfg -c 'program build/midicontrol-fw-full.hex verify reset exit'
flashApp: openocd -f openocd.cfg -c 'program build/midicontrol-fw-update.hex verify reset exit'
flashBootloader: openocd -f openocd.cfg -c 'program build/bootloader/base-bootloader.hex verify reset exit'
erase: openocd -f openocd.cfg -c 'init; reset halt; stm32l4x mass_erase 0; exit'
